exposure: mode of delivery (elective cesarean vs vaginal delivery with remifentanil analgesia)
cohort: 140 women referred to private hospitals, Tabriz, Iran, between 2020 and 2021
finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression was higher in women who underwent elective cesarean section than women who underwent painless vaginal delivery with remifentanil.
mod_finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression was higher in women who underwent elective cesarean section than women who underwent painless vaginal delivery with remifentanil.
